targets.authors: Schnall S., Benton J., Harvey S.
targets.title: With a clean conscience cleanliness reduces the severity of moral judgments.
targets.evidence_quote: Using materials obtained from JCD, the current studies replicated SBH’s Experiment 1.
targets.outcome_quote: Unlike Study 1 that measured naturally occurring response effort, Study 2 manipulated response effort on the sentence unscrambling task. Support for the cleanliness hypothesis was found among participants instructed to work through the sentence unscrambling task as quickly as possible. In contrast, when participants were instructed to work on the sentence unscrambling task attentively, no support was found for the hypothesized effect of the cleanliness priming.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The original cleanliness effect is supported under low effort but explicitly absent under high effort; the discussion states a boundary condition rather than an overall successful replication.
